ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP) adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (tax-effected in the aggregate 'Tax effect' line) plus gains/charges deemed non-recurring (sale of investments, restructuring plans fundamentally different from ongoing DBS productivity, acquisition-related items, early extinguishment of debt) and discrete tax items. From 2017 (ASU 2016-09) equity-compensation excess tax benefits above ~$10m/quarter anticipated are excluded. No adjusted operating profit or margin is published. Item after-tax amounts are from the release footnotes. Adjusting items in 2018: IDT acquisition-related transaction costs and inventory fair-value step-up (Q2-18), gains on resolution of acquisition-related matters, Dental separation preparation costs (from Q4-18) and discrete tax items. Release free cash flow table is full-year only: operating cash flow 4,022.0 - capex 655.7 + disposals 6.3 = FCF 3,372.6 (2017: 3,477.8 - 619.6 + 32.6 = 2,890.8; the table's first line misprints 2017 operating cash flow as 3,447.8); fcf_pub (quarter) null, FY stored in fcf_pub_ytd. FY2018 adjusted EPS 4.52.
